hypothesis: At a fixed public factual foundation and identical feedback-query budget, local microfeedback that compares predictions to independently revealed source consequences and chooses discriminating future queries may improve identification of an unnamed three-hop relation over passive source-blind inquiry. Equal-information exact symbolic active program search may tie, and any graph threshold may reflect information sufficiency, not emergent intelligence.
why: WSP118 varied static source knowledge. User proposes internal microfeedback is necessary for autonomous relationship expansion. WSP118 already used positive/contradiction counters but did NOT autonomously choose what new information to request.

fresh_source.kind: synthetic public fixture only, NOT independent science
fresh_source.seeds: 119000..119023 inclusive, fresh relative to consumed WSP118 118000..118023
fresh_source.world: 64 entities, six seeded independent primitive directed permutations and four distinct ordered three-hop target relations whose full-world functions do not equal any one/two-hop function; graph facts source-only; target law never exposed to any learner
fresh_source.public_labels: For each (world,law), one seed-determined permutation of 64 entity IDs. First 40 are candidate inquiry subjects; remaining 24 are held subjects, never available for querying or training. An observation query returns only that queried entity's destination under the hidden true three-hop law; candidate selector cannot see this before requesting it.
fresh_source.source_budget_max: 24 worlds*4 laws*4 tiers*4 arms*12 feedback queries = 18,432 total source responses, of which 4,608 per arm (no reserved/protected source).

arms.direct_active: One 216x2 signed-int32 local support/contradiction matrix, no gradients. At each step before feedback, choose a previously unqueried source among 40 allowed that maximizes disagreement among still-viable law hypotheses' predicted visible destinations, with unknown-path outcomes treated as their own bucket. Maximize Gini partition entropy, deterministic low-ID tie break. After actual source result arrives, update positive/contradiction counts only for fully visible candidate paths; missing paths do not generate synthetic negative observations. Count real contradiction microfeedback and entropy change. Every new source query has exactly one verified fact, never a self-generated unverified label.
arms.direct_passive: Identical 216x2 matrix and numeric update on exactly one real outcome per step, but inquiries follow a fixed source-blind seed-determined order instead of internal disagreement. Equivalent memory capacity, source answer budget and visible initial knowledge.
arms.direct_no_update: Same memory capacity and same passive source queries, but no local error-based writes. Must remain unable to declare a law; source receipt actions still count in budget. A simple falsification control.
arms.symbolic_active: Independent exact set-based program search with the same public graph, same verified source responses, same Gini disagreement query utility and 12-query cap. Uses Python sets/dictionaries, no candidate int32 weight writes. Strongest matched-information active control; expected tie or improvement, never called intrinsic uniqueness if equal.

prediction: After 0,1,2,3,4,6,8,12 source inquiries, declare law only if exactly one candidate has >=3 observed full-path supporting source examples and no full-path contradiction; otherwise abstain. For each of 24 separate previously unqueried held subjects, return destination only if visible three-hop path complete. Held responses exposed ONLY to the scorer after predictions, never to query selector or learning updates.
metrics: At each graph coverage and exposure point, record exact target law identity rate, true held destination top1 accuracy (abstain counted incorrect), prediction issuance, incorrect outputs, abstention, feedback contradiction count and hypothesis confidence, number of unique external source requests, cold byte-identical restoration and corrupted-checkpoint rejection. Require cross-OS bit-exact frozen source and outcome receipts. Report active minus passive and active minus exact symbolic (with paired 10k-bootstrap world resampling seed1190).
frozen_success: SOURCE_SAFE_MICROFEEDBACK_SIGNAL if at 75% and 100% foundation, at 8 inquiries, numeric-active improves held top1 at least 0.05 absolute over numeric-passive, paired world-bootstrap 95% lower bound>0, and all exact source checks/cold/tamper pass; 0% source not used. Stronger symbolic tie means ENGINEERING feedback improvement vs passive but SCIENTIFIC_UNIQUE_GAIN=false. If active fails, report MICROFEEDBACK_NO_GO without retuning consumed seeds.
negative: No guarantee smart query utility beats random; active selector may squander inquiries on unknown paths. If no differential, preserve a negative and propose another independent hypothesis mechanism, not posthoc threshold tuning. Internal self-agreement alone not external evidence.
controls_scope: Matched visible facts, labels queried, maximum 12 external answer calls per arm, same 40-source choice pool; different adaptive choices imply different measured source answers, as intended. Symbolic exact is a proper equally adaptive strong control. Do not claim equal CPU/FLOPs.
engineering: Preregister FIRST before implementation; source-safe focused tests and mandatory entire inherited regression on Ubuntu and Windows; generated-only G29 atlas source; do not use WSP116 real historical source, new scheduled tasks/controllers, owner-protected first-use, native Yggdrasil main or merges.
limitations: Toy three-hop class supplied in advance, no independent family or fully trained GRU/MLP. FKP-only public fixture cannot prove normal AI emergence or self-generating new relationship types; tests only whether an internal prediction-error/curiosity microfeedback loop increases efficient acquisition under frozen information controls.
